FN-ZQFGNWK-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 127
Committee: Fiscal Responsibility and Sponsor: Senator Linda Coleman-Madison
Economic Development
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 01/14/2026
Senate Bill 127 as introduced would provide for the continuance of the Alabama Board of
Examiners in Counseling until October 1, 2028 pursuant to the Alabama Sunset Law. The
provisions of this bill will not otherwise affect state or local funding.
